name: Heartbreaker
blurb: Active:  Viego  blinks with  displacement immunity to the target location, dealing physical damage based on his  critical strike chance to all nearby enemies upon arrival.

effects.description: Active: Viego gains displacement immunity over the cast time, then blinks to the target location. Upon arrival, he strikes the most wounded enemy champion nearby, dealing physical damage, slowing them by 99% for 0.25 seconds, and applying on-hit effects. Other nearby enemies are knocked back up to 400-units away based on proximity, though not through terrain.
All targets hit are dealt 120% AD physical damage, increased by 0% - 70% (+ 0% - 21%) (based on critical strike chance).
If a Possession is discarded, Heartbreaker will be placed on a 1.5-second cooldown if it is not already on cooldown.

notes:
Heartbreaker will cast at the edge of its range if the target location is further beyond.
Heartbreaker will cast at maximum range from the end of  Spectral Maw's dash if it is cast during the dash.
The knockback speed is 1000 units per second. The airborne is removed as soon as the displacement ends.
The maximum airborne duration is therefore 0.4 seconds. The minimum is 0.1 seconds.
To the struck champion deals  basic damage, but also triggers spell effects by also being tagged as  spell damage; to all other enemies, deals  area damage.
Viego will enter a 0.25-second cast time if he strikes an enemy champion.
After this cast time, he will automatically receive an attack command against that enemy. Previous movement inputs from the player are ignored.(bug)
Heartbreaker's strike to the champion can be  dodged and  blocked, but not  missed.
Viego will be ordered to basic attack the primary target afterwards.
